title: Vickers Wellington T2520
memorial_details: Cairn comprising various sized boulders, leading up to a peak. At top centre a large wooden Latin cross with a plaque. At the base a smaller wooden cross with metal plaque, date inscribed thereon. All six crew on board the aircraft were killed on return from a bombing mission to Bordeaux, 9 December 1940. No names are listed on the memorial.
inscription: Plaque on upper wooden cross: WELLINGTON T2520/ CRASHED HERE 10.12.1940/ ALL WERE KILLED Plaque on lower wooden cross: IN MEMORY OF/ THE CREW OF/ T2520/ REST IN PEACE
